name: Bugey Nuclear Power Plant detector halls

summary.plain: Rooms and a gallery at the Bugey nuclear power plant in eastern France, from 15 to 95 metres from a reactor core, where the Bugey detectors recorded reactor antineutrinos in the early 1990s.
summary.technical: Detector positions at 15, 40 and 95 m from a 2,800 MW_th core at the Bugey plant (Bugey-3), and 15 m for the Bugey-4 integral measurement. Marked with a campus-grade point for the plant.
